dispositions.reason: Post-claim return proves that this runtime lacks a representative JavaScript browser and an invokable browser connector for the required GitHub Pages navigation. No browser evidence or product mutation exists, so duplicating the same verification job without a newly observable compatible browser capability would only replay the boundary.

DONE return carries successful workflow and harness evidence for preserving contention-barrier routing in the compact frontier, with no residual debt stated. It is consumed as terminal and does not ground a successor.

DONE return carries successful source, served-browser and contract verification for the CURRENT-first mobile view, including the repaired safety phrase and propagated served bytes. No unresolved software debt is declared in the return, so no successor is grounded here.

The return deliberately made no product mutation because the required owner is a large live HTML artifact, this connector exposes full-file replacement only, and the worker's local checkout failed on DNS. A blind full-owner rewrite would be unsafe; rematerializing the same job is suppressed until a compatible bounded-patch or checkout capability is observably available.

dedupe_summary: The two DONE returns are terminal and non-conflicting. The two BOUNDARY returns concern distinct missing execution capabilities (representative served-browser navigation versus safe bounded source patch/checkout) and neither supplies evidence that repeating the same repo job in the current capability set would progress it.
